properties.name: `reflow2 init --harness vscode-cli` installs VS Code's terminal route: instructions, hooks that load the loop and nudge, skill stubs and slash commands, all committed and refreshed by update
properties.rationale:
The VS Code --call field report (art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02) left limitations 7, 9 and 11 open, root-caused in the three facts this event invalidates. The owner approved ideas 1, 7, 11 and 12 as one increment on 2026-10-05 (dec:the-vs-code-setup-is-built-as-one-increment-2026-10-05), carrying the hooks decision accepted 2026-10-02 (dec:idea-how-reflow2-triggers-the-loop-for-a-call-door-agent-in-vs-code) and the MUSTs of req:init-installs-the-terminal-route-for-vs-code-and-update-keeps-it-current, which stays proposed.

CHOICES MADE IN THE BUILD, each open before it:
- How the nudge counts a door write: from reflow2's own usage ledger, which the door writes for every call (the verb and outcome, never the object). That is the hooks decision's option (c) with no binary change, and it reads no command text, so limitation 20's class cannot arise in a reflow2 hook. File edits are not counted on VS Code (its edit tools are not documented by name), so the branches that need an edit count stay silent there.
- Whether the door harness replaces the vscode MCP entry or sits beside it: beside. `vscode-cli` writes no MCP config, and `--harness vscode,vscode-cli` writes both.
- Where the hook's export goes: the record init names, kept in the receipt, only on this route. The Stop hook exports only when the turn wrote and no MCP config names --export-to, never over a file that is not a reflow2 export, through export_graph's loss guard.
- Committed files outlive the git-ignored receipt, so ownership is a hash mark in each Markdown file, not the receipt alone.
- The owner's constraint of 2026-10-05, that the VS Code route must not change reflow2 for anyone using it as an MCP server: every VS Code file is written only by `vscode-cli`; an MCP harness's install is pinned byte for byte to a golden from main's installer; the pointer file (AGENTS.md / REFLOW2.md) is unchanged; no tool's arguments or reply shape changed. get_instructions' `sections` list gains one entry and loop_status's advisory for a harness with no trigger names VS Code's route.

NOT DONE: idea 8, the requirement's attribution MUST, which the approval did not name.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: A new init harness, `vscode-cli`, for VS Code where MCP is blocked. It writes no MCP config; under .github/ it writes the instructions file (served by the binary as get_instructions section `vscode-terminal-route`), a hook file (SessionStart and Stop, `reflow2 hook vscode`), a stub per served skill and a prompt per slash command, each Markdown file marked with a hash so update refreshes reflow2's untouched files and keeps edited and foreign ones. loop_nudge.py gains `--harness vscode`: SessionStart puts loop_status into the model's context; Stop counts the session's door calls from the usage ledger, exports the committed record when nothing else keeps it current, and nudges once. The `reflow2` command gains `hook`. loop_status reads the hook file as an installed nudge and no longer says none is possible for VS Code. tools/test_call_door.py drives the door in CI. An MCP harness's init and update are unchanged byte for byte.
